ops.text: Combined NIRISS SOSS and NIRSpec G395H spectra of the temperate sub-Neptune TOI-8264 b, for example, resolved its water absorption and constrained the atmospheric metallicity to $62^{+36}_{-26}\times$ solar [⟦new.A1⟧].

new_bib.text: A. Vachon, R. Gingras, N. Pouliot, M. Lapointe, F. Thériault, and O. Paquette (2026). A moderately metal-enriched envelope on the temperate sub-Neptune TOI-8264 b from JWST NIRISS/SOSS and NIRSpec/G395H transmission spectroscopy. arXiv e-prints.
